text: The Manager, Citywide Priorities, Toronto Building will provide a presentation on Overview of the Sign By-law and City Policy and Procedures.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 remain confidential in their entirety, as they pertain to the education or training of the Members. 2. Requested the Solicitor, Legal Services to provide a training and education session at its April 5, 2024 meeting, and a presentation on site specific By-law amendments, and the area specific restrictions under the By-law.
